description: This Java class implements a FreeMarker template transform for generating alternative URLs for content items within the OFBiz framework. It retrieves content-related data, constructs URLs based on content associations or default patterns, and integrates with OFBiz's entity and web utilities.

classes.name: OfbizContentAltUrlTransforms
classes.description: A FreeMarker template transform class for generating alternative content URLs based on content associations or default URL patterns within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getStringArg
methods.description: Extracts a string argument from a map of arguments, handling different possible object types.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Provides a Writer that processes the template output, generating a URL string based on request and response objects.

methods.name: makeContentAltUrl
methods.description: Constructs an alternative URL for content based on content associations; falls back to default URL pattern if no association is found.

methods.name: makeContentUrl
methods.description: Builds a default content URL with context path, view content, and content ID parameters.
